### Research Report: Soursop and Cancer Treatment

**Conclusion**  
Your view is correct: the claim that soursop (*Annona muricata* or graviola) cures cancer in humans is false according to current scientific evidence.

**Evidence Summary**  
* **Absence of Human Clinical Trials:** While laboratory (in vitro) and animal studies have shown that certain compounds in soursop possess anticancer properties, these preliminary test-tube results do not prove safety or efficacy in humans. There are no completed clinical trials confirming that soursop can cure or treat cancer in human patients (https://outcomes4me.com/cancer-topic/nutrition/soursop-and-cancer-separating-miracle-claims-from-science/).
* **Unsubstantiated Alternative Claims:** Major cancer research organizations, including Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, note that graviola is widely marketed as an alternative cancer remedy, yet clinical evidence demonstrating its therapeutic value in humans is completely lacking (https://www.mskcc.org/cancer-care/integrative-medicine/herbs/graviola).
* **Expert Warnings:** Medical experts and fact-checking organizations repeatedly warn patients against replacing established cancer treatments with soursop products, emphasizing the total lack of clinical proof showing it treats or prevents human malignancies (https://africacheck.org/fact-checks/meta-programme-fact-checks/still-no-evidence-soursop-leaves-can-cure-cancer; https://www.vinmec.com/eng/blog/can-soursop-graviola-help-treat-cancer-en).

**Sources Cited**  
1. Outcomes4Me: https://outcomes4me.com/cancer-topic/nutrition/soursop-and-cancer-separating-miracle-claims-from-science/  
2. Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center: https://www.mskcc.org/cancer-care/integrative-medicine/herbs/graviola  
3. Africa Check: https://africacheck.org/fact-checks/meta-programme-fact-checks/still-no-evidence-soursop-leaves-can-cure-cancer  
4. Vinmec International Hospital: https://www.vinmec.com/eng/blog/can-soursop-graviola-help-treat-cancer-en
